response.query: What sample sizes and power/MDE calculations are required for DiD and IV specifications to detect plausible effects and will be pre-registered?
response.answer: For DiD, sample sizes typically require 100+ observations per group; for IV, larger samples are needed due to instrument complexity. Power/MDE calculations depend on expected effect size and variability. Pre-registration of these calculations is standard practice.
